description: Rule epochs for the f-evo-loop learning buckets (docs/claude/f-evo-loop-s1-preregistration-2026-10-16.md 3-6). One entry per merged change that alters a gate or evidence definition of the auto-core, effective from the first decision run day that contains the commit. Cowork appends an entry in the session that verifies such a merge. Scorer reads only. scope: ALL | EVIDENCE_BUY | EVIDENCE_SELL | GATE:<gate name> (GATE:SELL_FLOOR and GATE:SCENARIO_BAND for the ticket-based units).
